A calm wellness area for rest, warmth, recovery, and private time with family or friends.
Hammam is a traditional steam bath with gentle heat and high humidity. It is an easy place to slow down and let the body relax.
Dry sauna is the classic kind, with high temperature and low humidity. It suits guests who like deep warmth, quiet, and a traditional atmosphere.
Wet sauna combines warmth with higher humidity. It feels softer than the dry one, so it suits guests who prefer steam and gentle heat.
